_doc: WP-Q8: layouts of world-kit pieces (world_kits.py). Blender frame, metres: x right, y forward, z up. A Quaternius wall module is 2 m wide and looks to -Y at yaw 0; `ring` turns every side's front inward, so a camera at -Y sees the north wall's face. Block types: ring (nx*ny modules of `wall` on the rectangle centre line, `replace` {side:i -> asset}, `open_sides`, `corner`), floor (nx*ny tiles), row (one asset repeated every `step` m from `from` to `to`), piece (one placement). The same layout is reused by any number of shots; `landmarks` name pieces the scene_set marks.

castle_courtyard.label: A walled castle courtyard, 8 x 6 m, south side open for the camera, a gate and a fort behind it

village_street.label: A plaster village street, a row of house fronts on each side

hill_castle.label: E2 Medieval: a castle on a hill above a river, a stone bridge, a village along the road, pines and a snow range

antique_forum.label: E1 Antiquity: a Greco-Roman forum in front of a columned temple, statues, market stalls and a crowd

harbour_square.label: E3 Early modern: a harbour town square, timber-and-plaster houses, stalls, barrels, a pier and Dutch ships

field_camp.label: E4 Nineteenth century: a field camp, canvas tents, wagons, lamps and a campfire, pines and mountains behind

pilot_room.label: Pilot room (the creator, 2026-11-06 15:25 UTC; fix round 15:52 UTC): a furnished plaster room, 8 x 6 m, a grandfather clock, a mantel clock, a table with two wooden armchairs, a bookshelf, a stove, a cabinet; host and guest seated at the table, the elder tending the stove. Each shot holds only what its LTX clip needs (in_shot, the creator 15:53 UTC)

room_establishing.host: talks at the table: the scene's speaker
room_establishing.guest: listens at the table: the scene's listener
room_establishing.clock: the room's landmark, seen again later
room_establishing.bookshelf: sets the place: a home, not a hall
room_establishing.jug: on the table, seen again in the insert

room_two_shot.guest: listens and answers with a nod
room_two_shot.table: between them; their hands rest on it
room_two_shot.candle: lights both faces; its flame may flicker
room_two_shot.bookshelf: the wall behind them: sets the place

room_close_host.table: the near edge under the frame

room_close_guest.guest: listens and reacts: the clip's motion
room_close_guest.table: the near edge under the frame

room_reverse.elder: tends the stove: the clip's motion
room_reverse.stove: he works at it; its glow

room_insert_table.candle: its flame is the clip's motion

room_two_shot.settle: both hold still, eyes on each other

room_establishing.motion: {host} talks with small gestures, {guest} listens; nothing else moves

room_close_host.start: {host} sits and speaks, one hand raised, to {guest} seen from behind
room_close_host.motion: {host} speaks and turns his raised hand over; {guest} stays still
room_close_host.settle: his hand comes to rest on the table

room_close_guest.start: {guest} sits and listens, chin raised, to {host} seen from behind
room_close_guest.motion: {guest} listens, frowns, then nods slowly; {host} stays still

room_reverse.start: {elder} kneels at {stove} feeding it a log, {host} and {guest} talk far off at {table}
room_reverse.motion: {elder} pushes the log into the stove and sparks rise; the two at the table talk quietly
room_reverse.settle: the elder sits back on his heels

room_insert_table.motion: the candle flame flickers and a thin thread of smoke rises

room_insert_clock.motion: the minute hand ticks forward once; the lantern light trembles

pilot_courtyard.label: Pilot courtyard (the creator, 2026-11-06 17:15 UTC, card 17:17): the castle courtyard of the kit, 8 x 6 m, south side open, the gate in the north wall and the keep behind it; the commander and the scout cross it side-on towards the gate.
